plugin.name: Runbooks
plugin.description: Runbooks an agent proposes and a person runs, one approved command at a time, with every output kept.

use.title: Use Runbooks
use.description: Read runbooks and run their steps on hosts you can connect to.

manageTokens.title: Manage Runbooks tokens
manageTokens.description: Make and revoke the tokens agents use to propose runbooks.

list.emptyHint: An agent with a Runbooks token proposes them; they show up here.

runbook.noSteps: This runbook has no steps yet.

step.missing: Values missing: {{names}}. This step cannot run until they are set.
step.missingText: Values missing: {{names}}. The text shows where they go. They do not stop this step.
step.notesPlaceholder: Notes for this step. Saved when you leave the box; agents can read them.
step.agentCommandOn: What the agent will run on {{host}}

runIn.terminal: Send to terminal only: this step runs in a terminal.
runIn.run: Run only: this step does not go to a terminal.

sendAgent.title: Send step {{position}} to {{label}}?
sendAgent.hint: The agent is told to look at this step. It reads your note in Runbooks; the notice itself carries no output or note.
sendAgent.history: Sent to the agent by {{user}} at {{time}}
sendAgent.historyNote: Sent to the agent by {{user}} at {{time}}, with a note:

run.ok: The command finished with exit code 0.
run.notOk: The command failed or a check did not pass. See the step.
run.byTerminal: Sent to a terminal by {{user}} at {{time}}
run.outsideDone: Run outside Termix, marked done by {{user}} at {{time}}
run.outsideFailed: Run outside Termix, marked failed by {{user}} at {{time}}
run.agentFailed: Marked failed by the agent {{user}} at {{time}}
run.pasteFirst: Paste the output first: at least one line.
run.pastePlaceholder: Paste the terminal output here, then mark the step done or failed.

input.label: Type into the command
input.placeholderHidden: Hidden: type here, then press Enter
input.endHint: Tells the command there is no more input (Ctrl-D)
input.prompt: The command asks for a password
input.hiddenHint: Hidden: shown as [secret:typed] in the output.
input.hiddenShort: Hidden here only: text shorter than 4 characters is not hidden in the output.
input.echoHint: A command may print what you type. Hide it for a password.
input.notYours: Only {{user}}, who started this run, can type into it.

repeat.titleStep: This step already ran. Run it again?
repeat.titleHash: This command ran on this host in the last 24 hours. Run it again?

decision.reopenHint: These steps already ran on the old choice and stay as they are: {{steps}}. Steps that have not run yet follow the new choice.

vm.mayHaveChanged: An earlier step may have made or changed this VM since: read it again to see it now.

does.stop: Shuts down {{name}}: HAW asks the guest to shut down.
does.stopForce: Turns off {{name}} without a shutdown, like pulling the plug: unsaved work in it is lost.
does.restart: Restarts {{name}}: HAW asks the guest to restart.
does.restartForce: Resets {{name}} without a shutdown, like the reset button: unsaved work in it is lost.
does.show: Reads the details of {{name}}. It changes nothing.
does.console: Opens the console of {{name}} in Remote Desktop. Mark the step done or failed when you are finished.

vm.waits: Then it waits until the VM is {{state}}, for at most {{time}}.
vm.asYou: HAW does it as you, with your HAW role and the host's own limits, and keeps it in its record.
vm.consoleOpen: The console is open in Remote Desktop.
vm.noRd: Remote Desktop has no host {{name}} here: is the Remote Desktop plugin installed, and can you see that host?
vm.repeatTitle: The same action ran on this VM in the last 24 hours. Do it again?
vm.forceHint: The guest gets no time to save its work or close its files. Use this only when a shutdown does not work.

notNeeded.title: Run anyway?
notNeeded.hint: This step is not needed: {{reason}}. Its rule: only if {{rule}}. Start it anyway?
notNeeded.readsHidden: This rule can't see hidden output: it reads what agents see, [hidden by owner]. Test the step's status instead, with a check on that step.

order.title: Earlier steps are still pending
order.hint: Not done yet: {{steps}}. Run this step anyway?

terminal.openFailed: Could not open a terminal. Copy the command instead.
terminal.timeout: The terminal to {{host}} did not connect in time. Copy the command instead.
terminal.missing: Send to terminal needs the SSH Terminal plugin. Copy the command instead.
terminal.noHost: This host is not available to you.
terminal.notSsh: {{host}} is not an SSH host, so it has no terminal to send to.
terminal.sent: Typed into {{host}}. Press Enter there, then paste the output here.
terminal.sendFailed: Could not type into the terminal. Copy the command instead.

tokens.title: Agent tokens
tokens.intro: An agent uses a token to propose runbooks and read their results. A token can never run a command. It may name only the hosts you tick for it, and it sees the runbooks made with your tokens.
tokens.namePlaceholder: Token name, like the agent's name
tokens.once: Token for {{name}}. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.revokeHint: Agents using it are refused from now on.
tokens.pickHosts: Tick at least one host the token may use.
tokens.noHosts: You have no SSH hosts to give a token.

notifyEnabled.label: Notify agents
notifyEnabled.description: Send runbook events (an agent's turn, a failed step, a runbook done, Send to agent) to a webhook, so agents hear about them. Events carry ids only, never output or commands.

notifyUrl.label: Webhook address
notifyUrl.description: The https address of the receiver that wakes your agents. http is refused.

notifyCaPem.label: CA certificate (PEM)
notifyCaPem.description: Trust only this CA for the receiver. Leave it empty to use the server's normal trust store.

colors.title: Step colors
colors.description: One color per kind of step: its border, glow, stripe and dot in the list. Leave a color empty for the built-in one, which suits light and dark themes. Icons and labels always show too.
colors.userDescription: Your own step colors. They replace the admin's for you. Leave a color empty for the admin's color or the built-in one.

notify.title: Signing secret
notify.description: Each notification is signed with this secret (HMAC-SHA256), so the receiver can tell it came from Runbooks. It is shown once.
notify.notRunning: Start Runbooks to manage its signing secret.
notify.none: No signing secret yet: notifications are not sent until you make one.
notify.replaceHint: The old secret stops working at once. Put the new one in your receiver.
notify.once: Signing secret. Copy it into your receiver now: it is not shown again.
notify.saveFirst: Save the settings first. The test uses the saved address.
notify.testOk: Test sent: the receiver answered HTTP {{status}}.
notify.testStatus: Test not accepted: the receiver answered HTTP {{status}}.
notify.error: Could not load the notification settings.

link.notFound: Runbook {{id}} does not exist or is not available to you.

error.stale: The step changed since you saw it. Check the new command before you run it.

stop.title: Stop step {{position}}?
stop.hint: Runbooks sends the command a TERM signal where the server accepts one, then closes its session. The run is kept as failed, with the output so far. A command that ignores the signal may keep running on the host.

checks.title: Checks
checks.failedHint: The step is marked failed even if the command exited 0. Read the output, then Run again or Reopen the step.
checks.failedToast: Marked failed: a check did not pass on the pasted output.

wait.early: The wait is not over: {{time}} left
wait.earlyReason: The wait is not over: {{time}} left ({{reason}})

stdin.label: Standard input: {{source}}
stdin.secretWarning: The command gets this secret on its standard input: check what it does with it before you run it.
stdin.useRun: This step gets input from {{source}}: use Run

secrets.held: The output shows when the run ends: this step captures a secret.
secrets.confirm: Captures secret {{names}}: kept in OpenBao for 7 days, never shown.

outside.pastePlaceholder: Paste the output here, then mark the step done or failed.

secretStep.makeHint: Termix makes the value on the server and stores it. Nobody sees it, you included; later steps get it on their standard input.
secretStep.askHint: Sent once, then never shown again. Later steps get it on their standard input.
secretStep.notStored: Secret {{name}} is not stored now: it expired or was deleted.
secretStep.repeatMake: Step made secret {{name}} already. Make a new value?
secretStep.repeatSave: Step saved secret {{name}} already. Save a new value?
secretStep.orderHint: Not done yet: {{steps}}. Do this step anyway?
secretStep.readByHand: Secret {{name}} is kept by hand now. Get it from OpenBao or Vault:
secretStep.readByHandStep: Secret {{name}} is kept by hand now (step {{step}}). Get it from OpenBao or Vault:

format.words: a passphrase of {{count}} words from the EFF long word list, joined by -

store.runbook: the runbook's secrets for 7 days (deleted when the runbook ends)
store.shared: the shared secrets in OpenBao Secrets: {{path}}

byHand.title: Do it by hand
byHand.save: In OpenBao or Vault, save it here:
